entities.summary: Short-form content, also known as short-form video, is a short video, or short section of a video — often made from various sources such as films, television shows, and entertainment videos — which are usually uploaded to the Internet through short-form video platforms such as YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, Vine, and Facebook Reels. Short-form content became popular among young people, gaining some popularity in the 2010s before becoming more mainstream in the 2020s.
